events.title: Demo 1.2.1: Searchlight, AZERTY Support, Tutorial Hints
events.summary: A small update based on your feedback:Searchlight: a brighter, more uniform beam with greater reach. Tip: use the mouse wheel (or D-pad left/right on a controller) to focus the beam — a narrower beam is brighter, while a wider beam covers more water.AZERTY keyboards: ZQSD now works for flight controls.Tutorial hints: no more overlapping hints! They now appear one after another, giving you time to read each one.Thanks for all the reports — keep them coming!

events.title: Demo update: reworked thermal camera and gamepad improvements

events.title: Demo Update 1.1: Camera, Performance and New Hints
events.summary: Thank you to everyone who has played the *DATUM: Rescue One* demo and shared feedback. We’ve read your comments, and this update addresses several of the issues you reported. Camera - The camera now pauses before moving back behind the helicopter, giving you more time to look around while flying. - During normal flight, the camera stays centered behind the helicopter. events.title: The free demo is out – try it before Steam Next Fest
events.summary: The free demo of DATUM: Rescue One is now available on Steam!Take the controls of a naval search-and-rescue helicopter, fly a search pattern over open water, find the survivor and bring them aboard with the hoist. No flight sim experience or joystick required.The demo includes two missions:- a short daytime rescue that teaches the basics;- Advanced Mode, unlocked after the first mission: a night search with a random survivor position, starting from a cold engine on the ship's deck.
